<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Online Shop" processRef="ONLINE_SHOP" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="ONLINE_SHOP" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="CUSTOMER" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>startLogin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>selectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>saveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>allSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>stopped</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enterPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enterShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>billingDiffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enterBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addrMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="SYSTEM" name="Shopping system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkCred</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>loginOk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>finishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>splitParallel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>joinParallel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>finalFinish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="BANK" name="Bank">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirmPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="startLogin" name="Customer starts shopping" />
    <bpmn:task id="login" name="Log in to the E-Shop system" />
    <bpmn:task id="checkCred" name="Check the credentials" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="loginOk" name="Login successful?" />
    <bpmn:task id="selectProduct" name="Select a product" />
    <bpmn:task id="addToCart" name="Add the product to the shopping cart" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="allSelected" name="All products selected?" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="splitParallel" />
    <bpmn:task id="enterPayment" name="Enter the payment data" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="joinParallel" />
    <bpmn:task id="finalFinish" name="Finish the order with address and payment" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="stopped" name="Shopping experience stopped" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Order finished" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="startLogin" targetRef="login" />
